name: tome-of-abyssal-heaven-lost-abilities-grants-nothing
notes: Tome of Abyssal Heaven: a Tome that lost all abilities grants no spellshroud. Tome of Abyssal Heaven (igmC01eEZn): "Other objects you control have spellshroud." Boundary: the static grant is an ability, so a Tome that has lost all abilities (NO_ABILITIES override, seeded as setup state -- only indirect proof of the real loses-all-abilities path) grants nothing: player 1's Fracturize offers the Mirrordepth's Blade and choosing it succeeds.

rulesClauses: An object that loses all abilities loses what its abilities grant: a Tome without abilities gives no spellshroud.
